notes.title: v1.1.0: "Now with 20% More Darkness"
notes.content:
Congratulations! You asked for features, and I responded by flipping the light switch and adding more bleeps. Here’s what’s new:

[b]Dark Mode Added[/b]

[list]
[*] Say goodbye to scorched retinas.
[*] Alphabetron now supports Dark Mode for those who enjoy their wordsearches like their coffee: mysterious and mood-lit.
[*] (Access to Dark mode is via a monthly subscription of just $3 per month... only kidding - you can access it via the Settings menu)
[/list]

[b]Two New Music Tracks Added[/b]

[list]
[*] We bribed a retro robot band with 3 AA batteries and a synth keyboard, and they delivered.
[*] Two brand-new banger tracks added to the rotation — now with extra zap, more funk, and absolutely no lyrics.
[*] You will dance. You will spell. Possibly at the same time.
[/list]

[b]"Final Form" Achievement Fixed[/b]

[list]
[*] Previously achievable only through dark rituals and sheer accident, this elusive trophy now works as intended.
[*] Players reaching the final level will now actually get the achievement instead of just vibes and disappointment.
[*] You're welcome, completionists.
[/list]

Thanks for playing [b]Alphabetron [/b]— the only game where you can relive the 80s, prove your literacy, and vibe to synth music all at once. More updates coming soon, probably when we remember how to spell "maintenance".

notes.title: Alphabetron Has Entered the Grid!
notes.content: [p]That’s right — [b]Alphabetron[/b] is officially live on Steam![/p][p]A 50-level word-hunting odyssey bursting with neon, nostalgia, and just enough sarcasm to keep your brain entertained.[/p][list][*][p]Smash through themed wordsearch levels like a caffeinated librarian.[/p][/*][*][p]Discover words about space, 80s slang, dystopias, and more.[/p][/*][*][p]Enjoy randomized grids so you can’t cheat (we thought of everything).[/p][/*][*][p]Unlock 21 achievements, like [i]Zap the Z[/i] and [i]Wordsmith Supreme[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Let the synthy bleeps and bloops lull you into a false sense of spelling confidence.[/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you’re a hardcore word nerd or someone who just likes clicking on shiny things — welcome to [b]Alphabetron[/b].[/p][p]It’s just a Wordsearch. But we [i]really[/i] overdid it.[/p][p]*if you spot any bugs or issues, be sure to log them in the community forum.[/p]
